plan.problem: After seeded, ordered initialization, repeated runs differ at the first optimizer update, especially in rotation. Test whether Adam epsilon amplifies tiny rotation-gradient differences.
plan.change: Experimental global Adam epsilon 1e-15 versus 1e-8; all other controls from the GPU seed study held fixed. Add first-update gradient/raw rotation trace equally to both modes.
plan.acceptance: Measure actual gradient magnitude and first-update differences before inferring a cause. Epsilon is a convergence parameter; do not adopt without full-training quality evidence. State readbacks can change execution scheduling.

raw_runs.measurement: adapter training, evaluation and export; excludes SfM and input copy

timing_scope: Adapter training/evaluation/export with the same instrumented local binary; excludes source compilation, SfM and input copy. OS/driver caches not flushed. Image trace is enabled equally in both variants.
quality_scope: Frozen historical shared-camera scenes; every eighth image held out from training but used in SfM. Compare RGB PSNR and Gaussian-window SSIM at long edge 512. Two repeats are exploratory.

gradient_analysis.scope: First-update raw f32 gradient and raw quaternion tensors, observed with identical synchronous readbacks in both modes. First Adam equation checked at lr_rotation=0.001.

observation_scope: First-step gradient and raw quaternion readbacks, plus exported PLY at steps 0/1/10/100, force GPU synchronization and may alter scheduling. Exported rotations are normalized; optimizer traces use raw quaternion values. Not a production speed test.

browser.observations: Fine pipes, cables and edges remain blurred or stretched; coverage gaps and floating fragments persist during roaming.

decision: Do not adopt global epsilon 1e-8 as default. It reduces early rotation drift but models remain nondeterministic and pipes mean PSNR falls. Keep optional experiment and traces; investigate rotation-specific handling separately.
